title: Exquisite Crisp French Praline Tart
description: A sour and crisp French dessert featuring praline, this tart is a perfect indulgent treat. It is halal-friendly and made with high-quality ingredients.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: chilled and cut into small pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour and confectioners sugar.
Add the cold butter to the flour mixture and use a pastry blender to work it into a crumbly mixture.
Press the mixture into a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Bake the crust for 20 minutes, then let it cool completely.
In a small bowl, whisk together the praline paste and eggs until well combined.
Spread the praline mixture evenly over the cooled tart crust.
Sprinkle the granulated sugar over the praline mixture.
Place the tart in the oven and bake for an additional 25 minutes, or until the sugar is caramelized.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Place the tart in an ice bath to stop the cooking process and create a crisp texture.
